name: boldfit-d2c-checkout
description: Minimal D2C checkout slice: catalog, cart, mocked payments, signed webhooks, order status.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
